trainingContext: Plastic Surgery / Burns / Reconstructive Surgical Unit

quotaDecision.reason: Per explicit user instruction, this dataset uses the exact per-skill counts the user provided (10 Interpretative + 14 Procedural = 24), which sum to the required totals exactly (no arithmetic discrepancy). The portal's own mapped minimums were NOT used to size this dataset - recorded in specialty-config/plastic-surgery.json for traceability only.

competenceLevelHandling: For every Procedural skill with more than one allowed competence level, individual rows use varying portal-valid levels (never multiplying row count) - see procedural_competenceLevelUsage in row-count-summary.json for the exact levels used per skill.
ageRealism: Burns and reconstructive trauma span all ages, so - unlike the all-paediatric Paediatric Surgery dataset - ages here vary realistically across the full lifespan per scenario (e.g. paediatric scald/flame burns, working-age trauma and reconstructive cases, and an elderly post-skin-graft nutritional case), rather than a single fixed age band.
